subject: Inventory Ledger: Purchase ID orchestration & line-item rectification
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodai.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@halcyon.tech>, ProcureOps <procureops@vendoronboard.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Inventory Ledger: Purchase ID orchestration & line-item rectification

Hi Sara / ProcureOps team,

Thanks for starting the vendor onboarding — a few specific asks so we can finish Purchase ID issuance and avoid invoice rejections: 

1) Please confirm the provisional Purchase ID you plan to assign for Halcyon Logistics and whether it will cover the full order or be issued per-line. We need the ID visible to finance by EOD Tuesday (2026-11-24).

2) Spend cap: our initial intake listed a $75k monthly cap. If you intend a different cap for the first 60 days (trial provisioning), flag it and specify the cap value.

3) Line-item mapping: attached is our ledger snapshot (ledger_snapshot.csv) with Redwood SKU, brief desc, and internal cost center. We have 3 lines that need normalization: 
   - RDW-INV-3301 (sensor modules) — vendor SKU currently splits into two invoice lines at your end; we need a single consolidated line to match Redwood ledger.
   - RDW-INV-3302 (edge compute) — vendor provided a bundled SKU; please break to hardware + install labor (two line codes).
   - RDW-INV-3309 (support SLA) — ensure this is tagged as recurring subscription (GL 6-470).

Attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and ledger_snapshot.csv.

Next steps: if ProcureOps can provision a provisional Purchase ID and temporary spend cap today, Procurement (Karthik) will finalize and we can confirm with Halcyon.

Thanks — Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Senior Partnerships Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Patel <sara@halcyon.tech>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodai.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@vendoronboard.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inventory Ledger: Purchase ID orchestration & line-item rectification

Hi Camila — thanks for the clear note. Quick answers below and attaching our supplier intake package.

1) Purchase ID: We can provision a provisional Purchase ID: HAL-PO-5390-PROV. That will be issued as a single umbrella ID that covers the shipment and initial install. We can split to child-lines post-fulfillment if needed.

2) Spend cap: We flagged a 60-day trial cap of $80,000 to cover expedited fulfillment. If Redwood requires $75,000 we can reduce it, but do note that freight and expedited labor pushed our estimate slightly.

3) Line-item mapping: we reviewed your ledger snapshot. For RDW-INV-3301 we currently render hardware and shipping as two lines in our ERP — we can consolidate to a single invoice line referencing HAL-L1-3301 if Redwood prefers. For RDW-INV-3302 we can present two line items (HAL-HW-3302, HAL-LAB-3302). For RDW-INV-3309 we'll mark as recurring code SUB-SVC-09.

Attached: halcyon_supplier_intake.pdf (onboarding answers)

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk the mapping.

Best,
Sara
Vendor Ops Manager, Halcyon Logistics

- Action items for internal routing: 
  * Karthik — confirm that Procurement will accept HAL-PO-5390-PROV and create child purchase references in our system.
  * Irene — can you prepare the invoice-match rule for RDW-INV-3301 consolidation (map HAL-L1-3301 -> RDW-INV-3301) and the two-part mapping for RDW-INV-3302?

> RDW-INV-3301, Sensor modules, CC 2101, Unit price $4,500, Qty 6

> RDW-INV-3309, Support SLA (annual), CC 6470, Unit price $1,200, Qty 12

Irene — if you can drop the invoice-match rule in PROC-4123 by EOD Monday (2026-11-23), we'll ask ProcureOps to finalize HAL-PO-5390-PROV and set the temporary cap.

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. Final confirmation and next steps: 

- Procurement will accept HAL-PO-5390-PROV and create two child purchase refs: HAL-PO-5390-CH1 (hardware) and HAL-PO-5390-CH2 (services). Expect those to be visible in our vendor portal by 2026-11-23 11:00 PT.

- Temporary spend cap approved at $78,000 for 60 days. ProcureOps, please set the cap and notify Halcyon.

- Irene: invoice-match rules approved as discussed. Please post the mapping under PROC-4123 and cc finance.

Sara: once ProcureOps confirms the provisional ID + cap, please submit any updated invoices referencing HAL-PO-5390-PROV and the child refs once issued. For your first invoice, consolidate RDW-INV-3301 into HAL-L1-3301 as you offered to avoid reject loops.
